<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:5">Snh. VIII, 5</cite> <he>כ׳ לרשעים כו׳</he> gathering (living together) of the wicked is bad &c., opp. <cite ref="Q00609"><he>פִּיזּוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:30">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵈ</cite> top <he>מקום כ׳ שיער</he> a spot of the body where hair grows in quantities.
